messages:
mika: Heads-up — proposing a console 'telemetry fidelity' toggle to raise sampling for route-level quota attribution. This will change what we ask SDKs to send. :thinking_face:
raj: Change the header name or extend the existing sample header? Breaking risk for older SDKs.
tess: UX: console needs a clear badge + confidence metric for routes in fidelity mode.
sam: Prefer backwards-compatible shim in SDKs reading both headers for 6 months. Minimal user-facing bump.
ivan: Could we encode as `x-rdwd-telemetry-sample: fidelity=1` (or `fidelity=10` for pct) instead of a new header? less churn.
raj: OK with extending. Spec needs to allow `0/1`, `pct`, and legacy float. Document parsing rules.
console-bot: Note: dashboard cardinality will increase when fidelity=1. Recommend previewing with small canary.
mika: Rollout plan: feature-flag gated, canary 5% orgs, SDK shims, 6-month compat window. SRE input needed on ingestion.
deploy-bot: rollout-flag created: telemetry_fidelity_toggle, env=canary, percent=5%
ivan: SRE: set ingestion lag and cost alerts. If route-level sampling hits 100% for hot routes we need auto-throttle.
sam: SDK snippet example to accept both forms:
```
# python header examples
"x-rdwd-telemetry-sample": "0.01"  # legacy pct
"x-rdwd-telemetry-sample": "fidelity=1"  # new fidelity flag
"x-rdwd-telemetry-metadata": "route=chat_v2;route_id=abc123"
```
raj: Console aggregation must tag data with source=fidelity|sampled to avoid double counting. Also update billing pipeline.
tess: UI note: proposed badge states: "Fidelity: ON (100%)", "Fidelity: PARTIAL (10%)", else hidden. Will mock in Figma.
mika: Action items: (1) eng-platform spec header parsing + compat (owner: raj), (2) SDK shims + minor releases (sam/ivan), (3) console badge + confidence metric (tess), (4) SRE ingestion alerts (ivan). I'll file RFC and tickets.
sam: I'll open Python/TS PRs early next week with parsing tests for both header shapes.
ivan: I'll draft SRE alert thresholds and cost guardrails.
raj: No objections to header extension approach from me. If no one objects by EOD I'll merge the RFC.
tess: +1 from UX.
mika: Thanks — will post RFC link here once created.
